title: Voltage: energy per charge
target: Interpret potential difference as energy transferred per unit charge.
criteria: Use volts as joules per coulomb.

authoring.limitations: Reasoning evidence only. Multiple choice does not certify physical performance. Teacher reviews before assigning and rates mastery separately.

cpa.prompt: A power supply has a potential difference of 7 V. What does that mean?
options: 7 J of energy per coulomb transferred between its terminals.
7 coulombs pass each second in every circuit.
7 J is its total stored energy.
Every connected object has 7 N of force.
cpa.guide: A volt is a joule per coulomb; voltage alone does not specify current or total energy.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

cpa.prompt: Supply A transfers 45 J for 5 C; B transfers 28 J for 4 C. Which has the greater potential difference?
options: B: 7 V, because it uses less charge.
A: 225 V, compared with B: 112 V.
Both: 5 V.
A: 9 V, compared with B: 7 V.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A 12 V source transfers 0.75 C through a load. How much energy is transferred?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A device receives 33 J while 3.0 C passes through it. What is the voltage across it?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: Two loads are both connected across an ideal 8 V supply, but their currents differ. Which statement must still be true?
options: The larger-current load has a larger voltage by definition.
Both loads must pass identical charge each second.
Neither load receives energy.
Each coulomb transfers 8 J across either load.
cpa.guide: Equal voltage means equal energy per charge, not equal charge per time.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Compare evidence and identify a physical relationship.

cpa.prompt: A disconnected battery still measures 9 V across its terminals. Which conclusion is justified?
options: A potential difference can exist without current in an external circuit.
All its energy has been used up.
Voltage and current are identical quantities.
The battery must supply 9 A through the air.
cpa.guide: An open external circuit can have voltage while carrying no steady current.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Select a claim supported by the stated evidence and assumptions.
